caveats: VISITS ARE NOT IN HERE AND CANNOT BE. The top of the funnel is not measurable from Firestore: analytics_events requires isSignedIn() so anonymous visits never reach it, and landing events go only to window.dataLayer with no GA/GTM wiring (src/landing/landingAnalytics.ts). Visit-to-registration needs GA4 or a Meta export.

Every rate here is computed over auctions that ENDED in the window. Auctions still running are reported separately and excluded — that is the plan's third hypothesis ("just timing") and it must not be allowed to contaminate the first two.

q1_auctionOutcomes.reserveAmountMissing_note: A reserve_not_met lot with NO auctionSecrets doc did not fail on price — the reserve amount was never stored (createListing write denied). Lowering reserves does not fix these; fixing the write path does.

neverStarted.note: first_bid lots with no endTime — clock never started, NOT 'ended'

q2_bidsPerAuction.why: The plan's fourth hypothesis: if bids cluster on few lots, the 126:4 ratio is misleading and lot-level conversion is the honest denominator.

q3_winnersPaid.soldButNoOrder_note: A completed auction with no order is the anomaly repairEndedAuctionOrder exists for — a winner who was never invoiced. Counted separately because it is a bug, not a refusal to pay.
q3_winnersPaid.cliqLive_note: paymentDefaultEnforcer deliberately skips an order with a live CliQ request (functions/index.js:1619). These are payments in flight, NOT non-payers.
q3_winnersPaid.sweepLag_note: 'defaulted' is written only by paymentDefaultEnforcer, which runs every 30 minutes (functions/index.js:1553). Up to 30 minutes of genuinely-defaulted orders will still read as 'past deadline, not yet swept'.
q3_winnersPaid.why: The plan's second hypothesis, and the one it calls existential: if winners are not paying, every dinar of traffic spend is wasted downstream of the bid.

q4_salesAndCommission.note: Take = 5% buyer premium + 5% seller commission (functions/settlement.js:244,268). Both figures are shown so a disagreement between what was stored at settlement and what the current rate implies is visible rather than averaged away. Mean AND median are both reported: with a handful of sales a single large lot moves the mean and the median does not.

q5_failedHandovers.definition: 'Seller unreachable after winning' = a PAID order still in awaiting_shipment past the 24h SLA. This is the product's own rule (bucketOrder + isOverdue in src/utils/fulfillmentQueues.ts, surfaced as seller_hasnt_prepped in actionQueue.ts), not a definition invented here.
q5_failedHandovers.THIS_IS_A_PROXY_NOT_A_FACT: Firestore records NO seller-default state. There is no seller-side sweep, no 48h seller-confirmation timer, and the server never advances shippingStatus past "not_started" — an absent seller simply leaves the order untouched forever. So this number is DERIVED, and it UNDERCOUNTS twice over: (1) it is point-in-time, so a lot that stalled and was later rescued by hand no longer shows; (2) the clock runs on updatedAt, which unrelated writes bump, silently resetting it (src/utils/fulfillmentQueues.ts:98-112). Treat it as a FLOOR on the failure rate, and do NOT compare it directly to the plan's stated 1-in-3 without saying so. adminNudgedSeller_* is an independent human signal — an admin chased this seller — but it exists only where an admin bothered, so it is also a floor.

q6_membership.why: D-106. The membership is defended as a seriousness filter. memberActivationRate is that claim as a number: the share of people who paid and then actually bid. Compare it against the decision thresholds in the COO baseline report.

q7_registrations.reason: Credential implementation provided to initializeApp() via the "credential" property has insufficient permission to access the requested resource. See https://firebase.google.com/docs/admin/setup for details on how to authenticate this SDK with appropriate permissions.
q7_registrations.note: Firebase Auth could not be listed — the service-account key probably lacks the Firebase Authentication Admin role. Registration counts are therefore MISSING, not zero. Every other section above is unaffected.
